title: Flatten nested arrays (Javascript)
description: Recursively concatenates nested arrays into one flat list, descending as deep as the nesting goes. Array.prototype.flat(Infinity) is the built-in equivalent.
how_it_works: Lab exercise: type the snippet into a fresh file, run it, and confirm the test outputs match. Then change one input and predict the result before running — Reduce accumulates; nested arrays recurse and concat, scalars append directly.

test_cases.note: Determinism check: re-running the snippet reproduces the identical output.

pitfalls: Very deep nesting can overflow the call stack — iterative with an explicit stack is safer.
use_cases: Tree walks, nested API responses, data normalization.
